_comment: Named lenses for the support desk example. Presentation, not language: a saved filter on the diagram, feeding no analysis. Committed, unlike the other two sidecars, because named lenses are worth sharing while layout coordinates and composer hints are per-developer. Deleting this file loses saved lenses and nothing else. See ../../../docs/design.md section 4.2.

Resolution._why: The process end to end, with the roster behind a port: what a ticket's life touches, and nothing about how availability is worked out.

Floor._why: Who is on duty and what drives it. Everything in the desk package is aggregated into ports, which is what a view from the roster's side looks like.

PiiFlow._why: Where personal data goes, and how little of the system it reaches. Only works because labels propagate: @pii is declared on two values in support.common, and from there it reaches every record, message and pipe that carries them — which here is the contact package and the one message that raises a ticket.

Perimeter._why: Where the system ends: the portal somebody types into, the console an agent works in, and the mail vendor. `label:external` selects annotations as well as declared labels, which is the only reason this selector can work at all.

Lossy._why: The one pipe that may lose a message, and the things on either side of it. An agent's heartbeat: nothing may depend on it for progress.
